headline: Quiet day: OECD publishes AI literacy framework for schools
body: A quiet day. The OECD released a framework defining AI literacy for schools worldwide, a small step for Global Coordination that slightly lifts Gatekeeper and eases Self-Destruction. Nothing else was scored, and the remaining lines barely moved as older stories faded a little further. Horizon Balance: +1.48.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.1, Self-Destruction -0.1, 1984 +0.1 — all from the OECD framework (Gatekeeper +0.10 from that event).
